```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
require(tidyverse)
require(ggplot2)
data(iris)
iris
```

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
hc_in <- iris |> sample_n(size = 30) 
d <- dist(hc_in|> select(-Species) )
hc <- hclust(d)
hc$labels <- hc_in$Species
plot(hc, hang = -1, cex = 0.6)
```

```{r}
km <- kmeans(hc_in |> select(-Species), centers = 3)
hc_in |> mutate(kMeansCluster = km$cluster) |> group_by(kMeansCluster, Species) |> tally() |> spread(Species, n)
hc_in |> mutate(kMeansCluster = km$cluster) |> ggplot(mapping = aes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width, size = Sepal.Length, shape = Species, colour = paste0("cl_", kMeansCluster))) + geom_point() + theme_bw() + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") + scale_shape(solid = TRUE)
```
